scope: Consolidation review follow-up, not a universal speed guarantee
method: Index references original immutable timing records by filename and zero-based record_index.
Each accepted general-sweep record has a quiet batch envelope and passes the current strict saved-record validator.
Each accepted supplement passes strict per-child load, correctness, execution and dispersion validation.
Both sides use the same MAD/median <= 20% rule; rejected raw attempts remain intact.
Coverage is a union of separately attributed snapshots and retries, never a fictitious single successful sweep.
SKIP denotes an explicit instrument outcome, not automatically a measured stock refusal.
Final supplement references replace withdrawn in-place float64 add candidates with explicit stock decisions.
Legacy qualification is representative named-version evidence, not exhaustive whole-module coverage.
